question: How does this-ness hold with melted mind through the I-excess?
premises: This this-ness of melted mind, may it not melt away for us even in the prior stage, for it is of equal lustre.
Now in the excess of the I-share the rule is boundless, in the spread of beings this śakti-power, supreme in the self-proved self.
inference: Melted-mind this-ness holds lustrous into the boundless I-excess where śakti reigns supreme.
plain_english: This this-ness of melted mind — may it not melt away for us even in the prior stage; it is of equal lustre. That now: in the excess of the I-share the rule is boundless; in the spread of beings, this śakti — supreme in the self-proved self.
